daily.today_energy: Your grounded energy is hitting different today. The cosmos is whispering that it's time to trust your instincts more and overthink less. You're exactly where you need to be.
daily.love: Connection vibes are flowing smoothly. Whether you're single or coupled up, authenticity is your superpower right now. Show up as yourself and watch how people respond to the real you.
daily.career: Your hard work momentum continues building. Today's a solid day to pitch ideas or take on that project you've been sitting with. Your focus and clarity are chef's kiss energy right now.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance today. Move in ways that feel good—whether that's a walk, stretching, or dancing in your room. Nourish yourself with intention and notice how much better you feel.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is asking you to soften up a bit, Cap. You've been grinding hard, but the universe is whispering it's time to balance ambition with actually enjoying the present moment. Trust the process.
weekly.love: Venus is sprinkling some gentle magic on your connections. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower right now. Let someone see the real you beneath that composed exterior.
weekly.career: Your professional vibe is shifting toward collaborative energy. That idea you've been sitting on? Now's the time to share it with the right people. Networking feels less forced and more organic this week.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional rest, not just collapse-at-the-end-of-the-day rest. Even 10 minutes of stillness daily can recalibrate your whole system. Listen to what feels nourishing, not just what's efficient.
